diagnostic_semantics.mitigations_json: Synthetic FAULT_CATALOG lookup for active effect labels; provenance output, not inferred.
diagnostic_semantics.possible_causes_json: Synthetic FAULT_CATALOG lookup for active effect labels; provenance output, not inferred.
diagnostic_semantics.probable_faults_json: Compact observation-only analyse_episode hypotheses; heuristic, not confirmed or probabilities.
diagnostic_semantics.rul: No numerical RUL column or invented RUL; unavailable_not_validated.

exclusions.reason: All identifiers, sampling/time metadata, scenario/payload/start/mode/phase categories, truth, named quality, labels, diagnostic health and catalogue lookups are excluded from X; only approved engineered numeric operating context is included.

bearing_failure.mitigation: Stop safely for severe vibration; inspect bearings and lubrication.
bearing_failure.possible_cause: Engine bearing damage increases vibration and frictional heat.

brake_wear.mitigation: Inspect pad thickness, stroke and brake cooling.
brake_wear.possible_cause: Pad wear increases actuator stroke and braking heat.

coolant_degradation.mitigation: Sample coolant, inspect leaks and service the cooling circuit.
coolant_degradation.possible_cause: Coolant contamination or aging reduces the synthetic condition index.

coolant_system_failure.mitigation: Stop safely if overheating; inspect coolant flow, pump and thermostat.
coolant_system_failure.possible_cause: Coolant flow loss from pump, thermostat or circulation failure.

engine_oil_pump_wear.mitigation: Check oil pressure independently, pickup and pump; service lubrication system.
engine_oil_pump_wear.possible_cause: Oil pump wear or restricted pickup reduces lubrication pressure.

gearbox_bearing_wear.mitigation: Inspect gearbox bearings and lubricant; acquire real vibration data.
gearbox_bearing_wear.possible_cause: Bearing wear increases gearbox vibration and heat.

gearbox_seal_wear.mitigation: Check leaks, oil level, seals and transmission pressure.
gearbox_seal_wear.possible_cause: Seal leakage lowers transmission oil pressure.

hydraulic_contamination.mitigation: Sample hydraulic fluid, inspect filtration and contamination entry paths.
hydraulic_contamination.possible_cause: Hydraulic contamination degrades condition faster than normal aging.

hydraulic_normal_aging.mitigation: Trend condition and perform scheduled lubricant sampling/service.
hydraulic_normal_aging.possible_cause: Gradual hydraulic lubricant aging during use.

low_oil.mitigation: Check oil level, leakage and pressure before continued operation.
low_oil.possible_cause: Low oil quantity reduces lubrication pressure.

overheat.mitigation: Reduce demand or stop safely; inspect heat rejection and lubrication.
overheat.possible_cause: Abnormal heat accumulation beyond same-context reference.

perception_degraded.mitigation: Clean and inspect sensors and confirm operation independently.
perception_degraded.possible_cause: Obstruction or environmental interference degrades perception.

piston_ring_damage.mitigation: Inspect compression, blow-by, cylinder balance and oil consumption.
piston_ring_damage.possible_cause: Ring wear or damage causes uneven combustion and oil consumption.

sensor_fault.mitigation: Verify with an independent measurement and inspect sensor/wiring.
sensor_fault.possible_cause: Missing, biased, frozen, drifting or noisy sensor measurement.

turbo_exhaust_fault.mitigation: Inspect turbocharger, boost plumbing and exhaust restriction.
turbo_exhaust_fault.possible_cause: Turbocharger or exhaust restriction changes boost and exhaust temperature.

unrelated_multi_blip.mitigation: Trend each signal independently and check operating context.
unrelated_multi_blip.possible_cause: Unrelated short disturbances without a shared mechanical cause.
